meta.title: docs: Upgrade Docusaurus from 3.7.0 to 3.8.1
meta.body_summary: Upgrade Docusaurus from 3.7.0 to 3.8.1 with required future flag and resolve useColorMode hydration error by refactoring custom components to CSS-based theme switching.

perf_labels.notes: Dependency upgrade merged after review to discard unnecessary changes and fix useColorMode hydration with CSS approach per Docusaurus docs.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 7543 changed lines across 19 files, the change is large by absolute volume, but primarily driven by pnpm-lock.yaml updates (90% of changes). The actual functional modifications are small (config flag and component refactoring). The merge outcome is consistent with a low-risk dependency upgrade that required iterative collaboration to resolve a framework-specific hydration issue.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer JonnyBurger reported ReactContextError in useColorMode after upgrade, then directed Copilot to discard an initial try-catch workaround and refactor to use CSS-based theme switching following Docusaurus best practices.
review_details.performance_claim: Upgrading Docusaurus from 3.7.0 to 3.8.1 improves performance and provides access to latest features and bug fixes.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent initially applied a naive try-catch safety check for useColorMode hydration error, then required maintainer-provided Docusaurus documentation to implement the correct CSS-based theme switching pattern. This illustrates a capability gap in framework-specific rendering best practices.

detection_detail.code_reading: JonnyBurger reviewed the initial try-catch commit, identified it as a hack, and provided the correct Docusaurus documentation on avoiding useColorMode in render.
detection_detail.manual_runtime_testing: JonnyBurger manually tested the upgraded site, discovered the ReactContextError, and later verified the CSS fix worked before approving.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes steps to start a dev server and verify features, but no benchmark data supports the general performance claim of the upgrade.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After CHANGES_REQUESTED to clean up and a later comment requesting correct useColorMode refactor, Copilot reverted unnecessary files and implemented CSS-based theme switching; approved and merged.

core_change_summary.description: Upgraded all Docusaurus packages in packages/docs/package.json and added the required future.v4.removeLegacyPostBuildHeadAttribute flag to docusaurus.config.js. After encountering a useColorMode hydration error, Copilot refactored custom components (VideoPlayerHeader, index.tsx, MultiColumn) to use CSS-based theme switching instead of useColorMode() in render. All unrelated changes were discarded per maintainer request.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: pnpm-lock.yaml accounts for the vast majority of line changes (6755 lines) due to dependency resolution; the functional changes are minimal.
change_trajectory: Initial upgrade commit bumped Docusaurus versions and added future flag.
Copilot attempted a try-catch safety-check workaround (commit b487c33).
Maintainer rejected the workaround and provided Docusaurus documentation advocating CSS-based theme switching.
Maintainer requested discarding of non-essential changes to custom.css, index.tsx, and MultiColumn.
Copilot reverted those files (commit 726622a) and maintainer further cleaned up.

review_signals.summary: Requested to discard unnecessary changes to custom.css, index.tsx, and MultiColumn after the CSS fix worked.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot reverted those files in commit 726622a.

review_signals.summary: Reported ReactContextError in useColorMode after upgrade and asked Copilot to fix usage.
review_signals.action_taken: Led to initial try-catch and later correct CSS fix.

review_signals.summary: Provided Docusaurus documentation explaining why useColorMode in render is unsafe and instructed to refactor to CSS selectors.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot refactored to CSS approach in commit 0aff241.

review_signals.summary: Confirmed implementation of CSS-based fix and later reverted excess changes as requested.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with Docusaurus upgrade and minimal config changes.
JonnyBurger reported a useColorMode RuntimeError about 24 minutes later.
Copilot deployed a try-catch workaround; JonnyBurger rejected it 3 hours later with Docusaurus documentation.
Copilot refactored to CSS-based theme switching; JonnyBurger then requested discarding of unrelated component edits.
Copilot reverted those files, and after final approval the PR was merged within 19 hours.
